app_fee.value: The application fee is CAD 103 and is non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: pay the application fee of $103.00 CAD

fee_waiver.value: The application fee cannot be waived for anyone.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee is non-refundable and cannot be waived.

gre_general.value: The School of Graduate Studies sets no GRE rule; any GRE policy is set by the program (see the program record).

toefl_min.value: Faculty of Arts and Science (science PhDs): TOEFL iBT 86 with no part under 20 (4.5 with no section below 4.0 on the new scale from January 2026); 79-85 may mean extra English courses, below 79 no admission. Engineering and computer science have their own minimum (see the program record).
toefl_min.quote: 86 or higher and no part under 20 in each of the four components. | Tests taken January 2026 or later (new TOEFL score scale): 4.5 with no section below 4.0 | Scores below 79: No admission

ielts_min.value: Faculty of Arts and Science: IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.5 in each band for direct admission; 6.5 overall with no part under 6.0 may mean extra English courses; some programs ask more.
ielts_min.quote: 6.5 with at least a score of 6.5 in each of the four components | Overall score of 6.5 and no part under 6.0 | Scores below 6.0: No admission

english_waiver.value: Exemption needs 3+ years of university study in a listed country; India is not on the list, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants who have completed a minimum of three full years of study at the undergraduate or graduate level at universities in the following countries are exempted from showing proof of proficiency in English or French:

also.quote: Applicants, regardless of citizenship, who do not meet one of the above conditions outlined, will be required to provide proof of English proficiency prior to their admission to Concordia University.

notes: English minimums are set per faculty: Arts and Science (sciences) vs the Gina Cody School of Engineering and Computer Science.
